page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number left and title right. Main text in one column of paragraphs and quotations. Marginal labels "Num. II.", "III.", "IV." stand in the left margin beside their paragraphs. Signature "WOLF." at the lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: mis in locis usurpatam esse in celebratione Coenæ DOMINICÆ. Neque ab ulla unquam aut usquam Ecclesia Catholica judicatam esse necessariam necessitate juris divini. Denique veteres in Sacramenti celebratione adorantes, non adorasse Sacramentum, sed solum DEVM.
main_text.head: In Confessione Scoticana, Artic. 21.

p.i: Nec signa loco rei signatæ adoramus, nec adoranda putamus, nec despicimus, aut tanquam inutilia & vana interpretamur, verum cum omni reverentia illis utimur.

main_text.p: Ioannes Calvinus, Lib. 4. Institut. Cap. 17. §. 37. Contra Papistas Disputans.

p.i: Christo, inquiunt, hanc venerationem deferimus. Primùm, si in Coena hoc fiere, dicerem adorationem eam demum esse legitimam quæ non in signo residet, sed ad CHRISTUM in Cœlo sedentem dirigitur.

main_text.p: Petrus Martyr, locorum communium classe secunda, Cap. 4. §. 39.
IV.Nihil interest, si Coenæ DOMINICÆ Sacramentum, stantes aut sedentes, aut genibus flexis percipiamus, modo institutum DOMINI conservetur, & occasio superstitionibus præcidatur. WOLF.

page.notes: Marginal labels Num. II., III., IV. are set in the left margin. The word WOLF. is a signature at the foot of the text, not a catchword. Scan is mildly blurred; some words in the first lines are uncertain. The Greek-style long s is rendered as plain s.
